environment: Claude Code cloud container used only as a development tool; Linux, Node.js 22, Python 3.13 with numpy 2.5.3 and Pillow 12.3.0, ffmpeg 6.1.1, local headless Chromium 1194

checks.command: bash scripts/check_all.sh (Node part: studio, workflow-kit, creative-upgrade, learning-mode, quality-methods, motion-toolkit with motion-quality, presentation)
checks.skip_reason: Opt-in browser review, export, player and renderer-parity tests; run separately with MOTION_REVIEW_BROWSER

checks.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_codex_install.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_package_identity.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_gepa_studio_pilot.py (optional GEPA dependency installed)
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_motion_benchmark.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_host_smoke.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_hosted_readback.py
proof: render.py search-to-cta.motion.json, critique.py --video, review-frames.mjs, text-audit.mjs, acceptance.py --composition-review fail
checks.detail: H.264 1080x1920 30 fps 600 frames 20.000 s, no audio; critique 95 (empty first frame warning), frame review 0 errors in 39 frames, text audit PASS 83 visible texts in 39 samples, acceptance blocked: A pass, B not_verified, C fail by Claude's key-frame judgement (text only, lower half empty), D not_verified

checks.command: before/after on the reel's failure cases (verification/perfua-regression-1.46.0.json)

checks.detail: 134 known validator errors and 20 of 67 failing tests, identical to tests/legacy-baseline.json; a tampered baseline was detected

review.text_audit: fixtures: clipped decorative word FAIL (WYBÓR 61.6% visible), same with data-layout-ignore FAIL plus ignore-flag, container that fits with hidden lines FAIL, complete Polish text PASS, transition mask PASS (transitional), declared exception PASS with pixel-review note
review.acceptance: a contract-only score of 100 leaves composition not_verified; a technically valid MP4 with a cut word is blocked; clean checks without a person's key-frame judgement leave composition not_verified
review.pacing: a 6 s drift of 4 px is flagged as still; the same shot with new content at 2 s and 4 s is not
review.not_verified: the original reel was not supplied; HyperFrames not run; no normal-speed viewing by a person; no host run

boundary: Source checks, fixtures and one rendered proof in a Linux container. Passing checks do not establish creative quality; the proof film itself was judged weak.
source: owner comparison of a vertical shop reel with a HyperFrames Studio film, 2026-10-09
